body:
Good morning, my friend!

The sun has been hot, and our bean plants look thirsty. Would you please help me water them?

The watering can is in the garden, by the gate.
summary: Water the thirsty bean plants in the garden.
done: The beans have had their drink, and the table is ready. Well done!

tasks.text: Water the beans in the garden
Say hello to Mrs. Ruth in the village
